description: This Java source file defines the UnchangeablePropertyException class, which is a custom exception used in the OpenMRS API to signal attempts to modify unchangeable properties of objects.

classes.name: UnchangeablePropertyException
classes.description: A custom exception class extending APIException, thrown when an attempt is made to change an unchangeable property on an object in the OpenMRS API.
